name: Default
shortDescription: Real-time monitoring for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby servers: track streams, analyze playback history and detect account sharing, backed by TimescaleDB and Redis.

alerts.message: First-time setup asks for a claim code: it is the CLAIM_CODE value in this template's environment, also printed in the tracearr container log on startup. The first account created becomes the only owner, so finish setup right after deploying.
